text: Native desktop/headless host ports, synchronized live document registry and nonblocking backend reads are staged. Local host readers wait for exact pending/deferred jobs and handle cancellation/resource close; the backend/IPC job surface remains available. Desktop publishes an immutable document snapshot across threads. Source review identified and is correcting fresh-run reservation/placeholder handling, old-cursor row publication after invalidation, and derived-overall report navigation bindings. Native JavaFX report equality/contrast-reuse test is added; integrated runtime and combined gate remain pending.
